notes: Sepolia (chain 11155111). Deploy all six contracts in the listed dependency order, with zero ETH, in one factory transaction. Constructor addresses and numbers retain the accepted values: 18000-second seasons, 118800-second dead-man, START 1791817200 and credit gas 1300000. Source fees, plea timings, panel 30 and quorum 17 remain unchanged. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner explicitly; the factory is not their owner. PleaLaunch snapshots PLEA.owner() as its owner and the committed hook's owner and 0.5% fee recipient. CabalGate uses Intake, the separate oracle fee asset (0x44a1...), pool IMD (0x2B69...) and oracle signer as listed. Seasons reads SEASON from the earlier CabalGate; PleaLaunch reads PLEA's owner and registers the earlier gate, seasons, laureates and distributor. PLEA.setLauncher retains both its deployment-transaction flag and deployment-block fallback for rehearsal. Atomic production deployment is required: separate transactions expose registration to any caller in PLEA's deployment block. PleaHook is not a manifest entry. PleaLaunch commits to its exact init-code hash; after launch, deployHook(salt, initCode) deploys it using a salt mined off chain for the required hook flags. That later call mints the fixed 1000000000 PLEA supply, 90% to the hook and 10% to PleaDistributor. Trading opens separately through seed(), callable by the captured owner any time or anyone at or after START. PleaDistributor's owner sets its Merkle root; PLEA's owner controls its add-only sender allowlist. These later operations are explanatory, not manifest initialization calls. Oracle request consumption prevents replay; first-delivery binding still relies on the accepted Intake.
